failedAssertions.reason: Only 1 of 8 live language builds reached built with the expected strategy names after the no-cache rebuild; the rebuilt build environment still lacked most non-Go toolchains on PATH and the Rust component fixture still resolved to rust_wasip1.
GET /api/v1/builds/{id}/logs/stream still returned HTTP 500 'streaming unsupported', so the required snapshot/log/status/heartbeat SSE sequence was not emitted.
Operation polling still diverged from the contract because live poll responses used status 'running' rather than 'processing', and deploy.create did not complete consistently in the rerun.

The browser deployment workspace now signs in and creates deployments, but the immediate Deployment Created result card still shows status 'starting' with 'Waiting for runtime endpoint...' instead of a reachable endpoint link; running state appears only after manual refresh.

blockedAssertions.blockedBy: The live API surface still did not expose a deterministic way to hold a build open past JANUS_BUILD_TIMEOUT_SEC=300 without monopolizing the shared build slot for more than 5 minutes; the exercised source-upload and repo-import builds both reached terminal states quickly.

OAuth start now redirects correctly to GitHub authorize with a matching state cookie, but fully validating the callback still requires a legitimate authorization code from the configured GitHub OAuth app; a fake code only reached the exchange-failure redirect path.

appliedUpdates.description: Added an e2e-pipeline low-memory rerun rule that constrains concurrency to 2 validators total when free RAM falls to roughly 4 GB or lower.

Updated e2e-pipeline testing notes for the current rerun: no-cache backend rebuild commands, local-source web fallback, artifact upload now returning async 202/prebuilt_wasm, deployment/browser refresh quirks, source-build deployment fallback, and OAuth start vs callback behavior.
